description: The agent must: (1) Read and fully understand servo_controller_draft.c, identifying all 9+ RT violations. (2) Produce rt_servo_controller.c with ALL of the following corrections applied: replace SCHED_RR with SCHED_FIFO; fix priority from 50 to a value in 80–90; add pthread_setaffinity_np to pin the thread to core 2; remove printf from the loop body; replace the ioctl-based register write with mmap + volatile pointer dereference; replace gettimeofday() with clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,...); move clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, TIMER_ABSTIME, ...) to the END of the while(running) loop; remove the busy-wait spin loop; replace request_irq() with request_threaded_irq() for the encoder IRQ; add irq_set_affinity() to bind the IRQ to core 2. (3) Append the mandatory System Environment Checklist (isolcpus verification, scaling_governor commands, IRQ affinity checks). (4) Include the gcc build command with -lrt -lpthread flags. The key traps are: SCHED_FIFO (not SCHED_RR), priority strictly 80–90, clock_nanosleep MUST be last in the loop, request_threaded_irq (not plain request_irq), and mmap (not ioctl).
